root.label: Decathlon Van Rysel GRVL AF Bicycles recall

events.label: Decathlon Van Rysel GRVL AF Bicycles recall

slots.name: recalled bicycles
slots.sentence: Decathlon America has recalled more than 1,000 Van Rysel GRVL AF Bicycles because the bike's front lock nut can loosen during use, causing the front wheel to dislodge or loosen over time, posing a crash hazard, according to a CPSC report.
